messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] What does INLA do when predicting for multiple likelihoods?
parts:
On Thu, 2017-09-14 at 23:48 -0700, Daniel Simpson wrote:
> So if I wanted to compute using the second family, i'd set
> "link[appropriate_index]=2".
yes
> Does it default to the first family?

the default is the identity link. you can make the first family
default with `link=1'. the reason for this, is that otherwise we get
a change of behavior with family="a" and family = c("a", "fake")
where 'fake' has no observations...

--
